facts.fact: OBS-CC says Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection gave organisations 18 months from promulgation to comply, a deadline reached on 23 June 2026.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 on personal data protection

facts.fact: OBS-CC says article 53 of the law creates the APDP but the decree installing it and designating its members had not been published by 14 September 2026.

facts.fact: OBS-CC says no implementing decree on data protection or the authority appeared among over 600 acts on the presidency's website on 14 September 2026.

facts.fact: OBS-CC says a 13-page draft implementing decree for the data protection authority is online on the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications site among texts submitted to public consultation under PATNUC.

facts.fact: OBS-CC says Douala hosted the ECCAS regional workshop on a common framework for cross-border data governance from 31 August to 4 September 2026.

facts.fact: OBS-CC says that in September 2025 the UN Economic Commission for Africa and ECCAS validated in Douala a regional digital trade policy with an action plan for 2025-2030 and a framework law.
